notes: Restatement of comparatives: this release moves the 2019 $57m cost of early repayment of Senior Notes out of 'Interest expense, net' into a new line 'Loss on extinguishment of debt' (Q4-19 interest now 36, FY2019 141). Prior-year segment expenses/OP are also recast vs the 2019 releases (e.g. Q4-19 Ratings OP 478 vs 473 originally; FY2019 Ratings 1,783 vs 1,763); segment totals unchanged.
Exhibit 5 is titled 'Operating Results by Segment - Reported vs. Performance' and includes an 'Adjusted Expenses' table.
No Exhibit 8 guidance reconciliation: the company gives no FY2021 GAAP guidance because of the pending IHS Markit merger (S-4 effective 22-Jan-2021; shareholder votes 11-Mar-2021).
Lease-related costs (non-impairment) are categorised OTHER; lease and technology impairments IMPAIR; IHS Markit merger costs ACQ.

Non-GAAP after-tax footnote amounts do not tie to the aggregate 'Non-GAAP adjustments' after-tax line in Exhibit 5 (the release itself does not tie; possibly the NCI share of Indices items and rounding). Published numbers kept; items_total_net is the printed aggregate.
Twelve-month column of the Q4-2020 release.

Income statement prints a separate line 'Loss on extinguishment of debt' 279 (expense) below interest; recorded in is.other_lines as printed. EBT 3,228 = OP 3,617 + other income 31 - interest 141 - 279. check_rec 'op+oth-int = ebt' therefore fails by 279 (3,507 vs 3,228); published numbers kept.

Gain on dispositions (16) printed as a reduction of cost -> gain_disp = +16 (MI $12m, Corporate $4m). 'Other (income) expense, net' (31) -> oth_inc = +31 (includes $3m pension charge). Segment-table total expenses 3,825 = income-statement 3,841 less gain 16.

Non-GAAP adjustments FY2020: OP 228, other income (3), loss on extinguishment 279, tax 109, after tax 397 ($1.64). Footnote after-tax items sum to 403 (computed, incl. -4 tax benefit) vs 397 printed; check_rec 'start_ni + items_net + amort = adj_ni' fails: 2,339 + 403 + 94 = 2,836 vs 2,830 published. Debt extinguishment after-tax is $223m in this release vs $210m in the Q3-2020 release. Corporate footnote items sum to 167 (12+19+116-4+24) vs 166 printed; Corporate (319) + 166 + 26 = (127) vs adjusted (128) published.
Adjusted total expense (company note) 3,474 for FY2020.
Indices Adjusted Net Operating Profit (attributable to the Company) = 503 (adj OP 684 less NCI 181).
